::: {#def-mcmc}
#### Markov chain Monte Carlo

A **Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)** method for a target distribution
generates a sequence of draws $\vparam^{(1)}, \vparam^{(2)}, \ldots$,
each drawn from a distribution that depends on the previous draw,
such that the distribution of $\vparam^{(t)}$ converges to the target
as $t \to \infty$.
:::
